description: A colorful modular system of labels, tickets, stickers, and varied content cards for any subject with several distinct ideas.

sectionPolicy.customization: Start with the selected goal order. Insert user-required sections at the nearest relevant decision point described in architecture.md; explicit user choices override the default. Keep hero first and footer last.

editingPolicy.textOverflow: Rewrite content to fit limits; never shrink typography to solve overflow.
editingPolicy.sectionOrder: Use the selected goal order as a default, then incorporate every user-required section according to sectionPolicy.customization.
editingPolicy.templateMayChange: Once before implementation; afterward only when the user requests it.
editingPolicy.factPolicy: Normalize supplied facts but never infer verifiable claims.

componentMapping.summaryOrFeatures: mixed-size cards, labels, and one ticket component
componentMapping.collection: hierarchical project or item cluster, never equal generic cards
componentMapping.ctaOrContact: high-contrast card integrated into the grid

rules: Map uploads by their stated semantic purpose, never by aesthetic preference.
A slot with css-placeholder fallback must render an inline CSS or SVG placeholder, not a file request.
Ask one compact confirmation only when multiple uploads have ambiguous purposes.

hero-primary.purpose: Primary hero image, product visual, portrait, or event visual

item-1.purpose: First work, product, article, speaker, venue, or content visual

lockedDesignRules: Use asymmetric fixed-position puzzle compositions rather than uniform card grids.
Keep object rotations, borders, offset shadows, and sticker quantities controlled.
Keep label component types visually distinct.
Do not add decorative objects beyond the selected composition.
Preserve content hierarchy and accessible DOM order at every breakpoint.
Theme changes cannot reduce WCAG AA contrast.
